## Columns

One row per team per game (two rows per game). 52 columns. A row is identified by `game_id` + `team_id`.

```{=html}
<div class="store-dict"><table class="table">
<thead><tr>
<th>Column</th>
<th>Type</th>
<th>What it holds</th>
</tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td>season</td><td>string</td><td>Season the game belongs to, written like 2025-26.</td></tr>
<tr><td>season_type</td><td>string</td><td>Part of the season: regular_season, play_in, cup_final (the in-season NBA Cup championship game) or playoffs.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_id</td><td>string</td><td>League game id, ten digits starting with 00; keep it as text so the leading digits survive.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_date</td><td>date</td><td>Date of the game in U.S. Eastern time, as the league lists it.</td></tr>
<tr><td>team</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the team this row describes.</td></tr>
<tr><td>team_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opponent</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the opposing team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opponent_team_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the opposing team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_away</td><td>string</td><td>home or away; at a neutral site, the team the league designates as home.</td></tr>
<tr><td>result</td><td>string</td><td>W or L; blank only for a game that was still in progress when the file was built.</td></tr>
<tr><td>pts</td><td>int</td><td>Points scored by the team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opp_pts</td><td>int</td><td>Points scored by the opponent.</td></tr>
<tr><td>margin</td><td>int</td><td>Team points minus opponent points.</td></tr>
<tr><td>ot_periods</td><td>int</td><td>Number of overtime periods played (0 for a game decided in regulation), from the minutes played; blank in the rare game whose recorded minutes do not add up.</td></tr>
<tr><td>minutes</td><td>float</td><td>Total player minutes for the team (240 in a regulation game, 25 more per overtime).</td></tr>
<tr><td>fgm</td><td>int</td><td>Field goals made by the team, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fga</td><td>int</td><td>Field goals attempted by the team, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fg3m</td><td>int</td><td>Three-point field goals made by the team, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fg3a</td><td>int</td><td>Three-point field goals attempted by the team, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>ftm</td><td>int</td><td>Free throws made by the team, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fta</td><td>int</td><td>Free throws attempted by the team, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>oreb</td><td>int</td><td>Offensive rebounds by the team, summed from its player lines; rebounds credited to the team rather than a player are not included.</td></tr>
<tr><td>dreb</td><td>int</td><td>Defensive rebounds by the team, summed from its player lines; rebounds credited to the team rather than a player are not included.</td></tr>
<tr><td>reb</td><td>int</td><td>Total rebounds by the team, summed from its player lines; rebounds credited to the team rather than a player are not included.</td></tr>
<tr><td>ast</td><td>int</td><td>Assists by the team, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>stl</td><td>int</td><td>Steals by the team, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>blk</td><td>int</td><td>Blocked shots by the team, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>tov</td><td>int</td><td>Turnovers by the team, summed from its player lines; turnovers charged to the team rather than a player are not included.</td></tr>
<tr><td>pf</td><td>int</td><td>Personal fouls by the team, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opp_fgm</td><td>int</td><td>Field goals made by the opponent, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opp_fga</td><td>int</td><td>Field goals attempted by the opponent, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opp_fg3m</td><td>int</td><td>Three-point field goals made by the opponent, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opp_fg3a</td><td>int</td><td>Three-point field goals attempted by the opponent, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opp_ftm</td><td>int</td><td>Free throws made by the opponent, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opp_fta</td><td>int</td><td>Free throws attempted by the opponent, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opp_oreb</td><td>int</td><td>Offensive rebounds by the opponent, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opp_dreb</td><td>int</td><td>Defensive rebounds by the opponent, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opp_reb</td><td>int</td><td>Total rebounds by the opponent, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opp_ast</td><td>int</td><td>Assists by the opponent, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opp_stl</td><td>int</td><td>Steals by the opponent, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opp_blk</td><td>int</td><td>Blocked shots by the opponent, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opp_tov</td><td>int</td><td>Turnovers by the opponent, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opp_pf</td><td>int</td><td>Personal fouls by the opponent, summed from its player lines.</td></tr>
<tr><td>possessions</td><td>float</td><td>Estimated team possessions: FGA + 0.44 x FTA - OREB + TOV.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opp_possessions</td><td>float</td><td>Estimated opponent possessions, by the same formula on the opponent&#x27;s totals.</td></tr>
<tr><td>pace</td><td>float</td><td>Possessions per 48 minutes: 48 x (possessions + opp_possessions) / (2 x game minutes), where game minutes is the team minutes divided by 5 (48 in regulation, 5 more per overtime).</td></tr>
<tr><td>off_rating</td><td>float</td><td>Points scored per 100 possessions: 100 x pts / possessions.</td></tr>
<tr><td>def_rating</td><td>float</td><td>Points allowed per 100 opponent possessions: 100 x opp_pts / opp_possessions.</td></tr>
<tr><td>rest_days</td><td>int</td><td>Full days off for the team since its previous game in this file (0 is the second night of a back-to-back); blank for its first game of the season.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opp_rest_days</td><td>int</td><td>Full days off for the opponent since its previous game in this file; blank for its first game of the season.</td></tr>
<tr><td>starters</td><td>string</td><td>The team&#x27;s five starters, full names in alphabetical order separated by semicolons; blank for the rare game with no starting lineup on record.</td></tr>
<tr><td>starter_ids</td><td>string</td><td>League player ids of the five starters, in the same order as starters, separated by semicolons.</td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>
```

## Source and method

Compiled by Slam Dunk Bets from the NBA's official game statistics. Team totals are the sums of the player box score lines; possessions, pace and ratings are estimates computed by the formulas in the column descriptions.

The same file layout, IDs and column names are used for every season, so seasons stack without cleanup. See [how the store works](help.qmd) for formats, delivery and the license.

## More NBA data

[Player Game Logs](nba-player-logs.qmd) · [Play-by-Play](nba-play-by-play.qmd) · [Games and Results](nba-schedule.qmd) · [First Events](nba-first-events.qmd) · [All NBA data](nba.qmd)

::: {.faq-item}
### How do the NBA files join to each other?

On the ID columns. Game, team and player IDs are the same strings in every NBA file and every season, so a join on `game_id` (plus `team` or `player_id` where the grain needs it) lines them up.
:::

::: {.faq-item}
### Which games are included?

Every regular-season, play-in, Cup final and playoff game, from the official box scores and play-by-play. Regular season and postseason sit in the same file, told apart by `season_type`. Preseason and All-Star games are left out.
:::
